name: TecOps H — Log de erros (configure como Error Workflow)

parameters.query: INSERT INTO tecops_execution_logs (run_key,kind,status,stage,finished_at,summary,error_message) VALUES($1::text,$2::text,'failed',$3::text,NOW(),jsonb_build_object('workflow',$4::text),$5::text) ON CONFLICT(run_key) DO UPDATE SET status='failed',stage=EXCLUDED.stage,finished_at=NOW(),error_message=EXCLUDED.error_message,summary=tecops_execution_logs.summary||EXCLUDED.summary RETURNING run_key,status;
